messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — I ran the weekly docs snapshot scan and found ~7 broken internal anchors and 3 images returning 403 in /guides and /runtime. Pinging owners for quick follow-ups: @maya @ryan

docs-bot: scan output (trimmed):
```
/guides/serving#batching -> 404 anchor not found
/runtime/kv-cache -> anchor missing
/assets/images/runtime/compile.png -> 403
/assets/images/guides/batching-diagram.svg -> 403
```

maya: I own /guides/serving — I'll open a PR to fix anchors + add redirects. ETA today EOD. Quick Q: I see anchors named both `batching` and `batching-config` across files, which one should be canonical?

ryan: I can take the image 403s — probably S3->CDN perms after the last sync. I'll try a redeploy of the image bucket policy and let you know.

olivia: If anyone edits frontmatter redirects please cc me — our redirect audit may conflict if we add new rules.

sam: Found small typos in runtime/compilation.md: 'kernal' -> 'kernel' and one extra "the". I'll submit a 1-line PR for that.

anya: Thanks. Maya + Ryan I'm assigning the anchor and image fixes to you. If PRs are tiny we can fast-track reviews — @olivia ok to fast-merge trivial fixes? :eyes: 

olivia: Fine for 1-2 line fixes and anchor renames as long as PR includes a link to the failing check and a brief description of the change. :+1: 

maya: Opening PR: 1813500123-fix-anchors-guides. Added a tiny test to catch missing anchors. @docs-bot can you re-run the linkcheck after the PR merges?

.docs-bot: Linkcheck queued — running now, ETA ~5m.

.docs-bot: Linkcheck result: 6 failures remaining (2 anchors, 4 images). Ryan's image perms still failing.

ryan: I pushed a perms update to the image bucket and invalidated the CDN cache. Try re-running.

.docs-bot: Re-run complete: all links/images now passing. :tada: 

anya: Awesome. Can someone add a one-line note to the docs-owner matrix about anchor ownership for /guides and /runtime so this is clearer next time? Also create a small follow-up ticket for auditing anchors monthly.

maya: Added a line to docs-owners.md and created ticket DOCS-4325 (anchor ownership + monthly scan).

sam: PR for typo merged.

olivia: Thanks all — looks resolved from my side. Closing thread.
